# clo_storage_s3_user_keys (Resource)

Rotate the S3 user's credentials. Destroy forgets the credentials. CLO has no key revocation endpoint.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) ID of the user for whom the keys will be generated

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `access_key` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive)

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String)
- `delete` (String)
- `read` (String)
- `update` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import reads the current access key. CLO returns the secret only when keys are generated.
terraform import clo_storage_s3_user_keys.example USER_ID
```
